rows.aname: จำนวนประชากรไทย อายุ 35 ปีขึ้นไป ได้รับการตรวจวัดระดับน้ำตาลในรอบปี
rows.bname: จำนวนประชากรไทย อายุ 35 ปีขึ้นไปที่ไม่ป่วยด้วยโรคเบาหวาน
rows.notice:
ใช้ฐานประชากรจาก 43 แฟ้มเนื่องจากประชากร สนย.รายหมู่ไม่แยกกลุ่มอายุ
เป้าหมาย = คำนวนจากแฟ้ม person ที่มี typearea = 1,3 และมีสัญชาติไทย โดยปรับเกลี่ยให้เหลือคนที่เลขประชาชนไม่ซำ้กัน
เหลือเพียง 1 CID 1 Record ต่อจังหวัด และต้องไม่ป่วยด้วยโรคเบาหวาน [การคิดป่วยคิดจากแฟ้ม Chronic และ Diagnosis_opd ตาม CID]
ผลงาน = คำนวนจากแฟ้ม ncdscreen ที่เชื่อมโยงกับแฟ้มเป้าหมายได้ และมีค่าการตรวจนำ้ตาล BLEVEL >0

[เงื่อนไขการปรับเกลี่ยประชากร คือ หากมี record ในแฟ้ม person ซ้ากันด้วยเลขประชาชน จะยกคนนั้นให้หน่วยบริการที่มี D_update ล่าสุด
โดยลำดับการนำเข้าจะเรียงตาม d_update DESC, typearea ASC ทำใน typearea 1,3 ก่อนแล้วจึงทำ typearea อื่นๆ
ขณะนำเข้าจะตรวจสอบการซำ้ของ CID หากซ้ำจะไม่นำเข้า]

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("pop_group2") as "target2" ,SUM("pop_group3") as "target3" ,SUM("pop_group4") as "target4" ,SUM("result_group2") as "result2" ,SUM("result_group3") as "result3" ,SUM("result_group4") as "result4" ,SUM("pop_group2_1") as "target2_1" ,SUM("pop_group3_1") as "target3_1" ,SUM("pop_group4_1") as "target4_1" ,SUM("pop_group2_2") as "target2_2" ,SUM("pop_group3_2") as "target3_2" ,SUM("pop_group4_2") as "target4_2" ,SUM("result_group2_1") as "result2_1" ,SUM("result_group3_1") as "result3_1" ,SUM("result_group4_1") as "result4_1" ,SUM("result_group2_2") as "result2_2" ,SUM("result_group3_2") as "result3_2" ,SUM("result_group4_2") as "result4_2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM("pop_group2") as "target2" ,SUM("pop_group3") as "target3" ,SUM("pop_group4") as "target4" ,SUM("result_group2") as "result2" ,SUM("result_group3") as "result3" ,SUM("result_group4") as "result4" ,SUM("pop_group2_1") as "target2_1" ,SUM("pop_group3_1") as "target3_1" ,SUM("pop_group4_1") as "target4_1" ,SUM("pop_group2_2") as "target2_2" ,SUM("pop_group3_2") as "target3_2" ,SUM("pop_group4_2") as "target4_2" ,SUM("result_group2_1") as "result2_1" ,SUM("result_group3_1") as "result3_1" ,SUM("result_group4_1") as "result4_1" ,SUM("result_group2_2") as "result2_2" ,SUM("result_group3_2") as "result3_2" ,SUM("result_group4_2") as "result4_2"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN('05','06','07','11','12','15') AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode

service_plan_hospital.query: SELECT h.hcode as a_code ,CONCAT(h.splevel,':',h.hname) as a_name , SUM(pop_group2) as target2 ,SUM(pop_group3) as target3      ,SUM(pop_group4) as target4  ,SUM(result_group2) as result2  ,SUM(result_group3) as result3   ,SUM(result_group4) as result4   ,SUM(pop_group2_1) as target2_1 ,SUM(pop_group3_1) as target3_1      ,SUM(pop_group4_1) as target4_1  ,SUM(pop_group2_2) as target2_2 ,SUM(pop_group3_2) as target3_2      ,SUM(pop_group4_2) as target4_2  ,SUM(result_group2_1) as result2_1  ,SUM(result_group3_1) as result3_1   ,SUM(result_group4_1) as result4_1   ,SUM(result_group2_2) as result2_2 ,SUM(result_group3_2) as result3_2   ,SUM(result_group4_2) as result4_2   FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(h.regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
